what_this_is: The persistence invariant for teardown. The owner set NO balance floor and instructed that credits be drained, which inverts the safety model: instead of protecting spend, every artifact must already be durable at every moment, so an instance dying at zero balance costs compute only and never evidence. This manifest is the proof of that invariant.

jl-vm-473501 (8x): ~/logs (serve logs, gate receipts, needle receipts, A/B ladders)
main-omp-session (471041): nothing host-only: this box IS the repo working tree, already committed and pushed

git (small, load-bearing).contents: every result.json, every metrics JSONL, the GPU telemetry CSVs, the 8x serve/gate/needle logs, models.yml
git (small, load-bearing).why: these are the files a future reader needs to re-derive or audit any published number

already-committed duplicates.why: 71 pulled files were byte-identical to files already committed in the repo - chiefly the ladder receipts, which were authored here and copied to the driver. Re-storing them would inflate the repo for zero durability gain, so the manifest PROVES the match and the copy was dropped.

files.contents: per-task agent transcripts, oracle outputs, per-trial logs across all TB2.1 arms

HF dataset (bulky, forensic).why: forensically valuable but not load-bearing; a dataset repo is the correct home for tens of MiB of blobs

deliberately_NOT_persisted.reason: 1.6 GB asciinema capture from a single task that has never resolved in any arm. It is 74 % of all job-directory bytes on the driver. The task emulates a Windows 3.11 install and spews unbounded terminal output; the recording carries no measurement and no rope signal. Excluding it also motivated the pre-registered exclusion of that task from the 512k arm on disk-safety grounds.
545 MB tmux pane dump from the same runaway task, same reasoning.
process IDs of dead processes on hosts about to be destroyed; meaningless once the host is gone.

deliberately_NOT_persisted.item: docker images (vllm:gg-r34-tb21-sr1 and the four ab-* variants) on the 8x host
deliberately_NOT_persisted.reason: Reproducible from committed inputs: the base digest is pinned in receipts/production-image.json (sha256:820181fbbc...) and every patch layer is a committed .patch file, with the byte-level md5 matrix of all four A/B variants recorded in receipts/kernel-gap-bare-metal-ab.json. Re-buildable, so not worth 50 GB of transfer against a draining balance.

deliberately_NOT_persisted.item: model weights on both hosts (/home/ubuntu/models/qwen38-hyd, 21 GB)
deliberately_NOT_persisted.reason: published on the Hub as malaiwah/Qwen3.8-27B-EXL3-K5K6-hydrated and sha-verified on arrival; the Hub copy IS the canonical one.

deliberately_NOT_persisted.item: the omp tmux session state on the driver
deliberately_NOT_persisted.reason: an interactive session, not an artifact; its transcripts live under ~/.omp/agent/sessions which is not a measurement source.

invariant_statement: At the time of writing, every file on every rental is in exactly one of four states: committed to git, proven byte-identical to something already committed, uploaded to the HF dataset, or listed above with a reason. There is no unexplained residue. An instance dying now costs compute only.

verification.how: re-run the sweep and diff against this manifest; every git-bound entry's sha256 must match the committed file, and the HF archives are addressed by repo path
